name: pullover-stability-ball-with-weight
title: Pullover: Stability Ball with Weight
primer: This is an exercise for back, shoulders, and neck strengthening.
steps: Grasp a Barbell or Dumbbell and sit on a Ball with your feet firmly placed on the floor.
Lower your body so your upper back and shoulders are the only part of your body supported on the Ball.
Bring the Barbell or Dumbbell to your chest with your arms extended.
In an arcing motion raise the Barbell or Dumbbell over and behind your head towards the floor.
